text: To be venerated is to be treated with deep respect, almost like something holy. Here, many people see Ram as the perfect son, husband, brother and king.
Stilted speech sounds stiff and unnatural, as if nobody would really talk that way. Here, the film's dialogue makes the characters feel less real.
Flamboyant means bold, showy and full of style. Here, the demon Ravana is more eye-catching than the perfect hero.
The box office is the money a movie earns from ticket sales, and also the ranking of movies by that money. Here, the film is number one in India.
A cinematic universe is a group of movies and other stories set in one shared world, like Marvel's superhero films. Here, the producers hope to build one from the Ramayana.
An epic is a very long story, often a poem, about heroes and great battles. Here, the Ramayana is one that is about 3,000 years old.
To triumph is to win a big victory. Here, good beats evil in the story.
Cosmic order means the way the universe is meant to be, balanced and fair. Here, it is the peace that returns when the demon loses.
Splashy means flashy and designed to get lots of attention. Splashiest means the most of that. Here, this is the most dazzling retelling yet.
An instalment is one part of something that comes out in pieces, such as one movie in a two-part story.
An adaptation is a story changed into a new form, such as a poem turned into a movie.
Diwali is the Hindu festival of lights, celebrated in autumn with lamps, sweets and family. The second film is planned for around then in 2028.
A spin-off is a new story that grows out of an older one, often following a side character.
Merchandise means things sold to fans, like toys, shirts and posters, based on a movie or show.
Hans Zimmer is a famous composer who writes music for movies. He helped write the film's score.
Oscar-winning means having won an Academy Award, the biggest prize in American film.
A composer is a person who writes music.
DNEG is a company that makes visual effects, the computer-made images in big movies.
Visual effects are images made or changed by computers, like flying creatures or giant explosions.
Mythological means about myths, the ancient stories of gods and heroes.
A dividend is a payoff from an investment. Here the writer is making a pun: the money spent has paid off, and the story is about gods.
Sumptuous means rich, grand and lovely to look at. Here, the film's pictures are gorgeous and clearly expensive.
A feast is a big meal. A visual feast is something so full of beautiful images that your eyes feel well fed.
A demi-god is a being who is partly a god. Here, a great vulture with godlike powers attacks a chariot.
A staple is something that is always there, a usual main part. Here, slow-motion hero shots are a regular part of Indian movies.
To be mesmerised is to be so fascinated that you cannot look away.
A spectacle is a dazzling show with lots to see. Here, the film puts big visuals ahead of a good story.
To neglect something is to not give it enough care or attention. Here, the director paid too little attention to story and characters.
Craft means the skill and technique needed to make something well, like writing or filming.
Character development is how a story shows a person growing and changing, so we get to know them.
To tick off a list is to mark each item as done. Here, the plot rushes through famous scenes one by one, like a checklist.
Dharma is a Hindu idea meaning doing what is right and living by your duty. The article glosses it as righteousness.
Righteousness means being morally good and doing the right thing.
Flawless means having no flaws or faults at all.
Compelling means so interesting that you can't stop watching or reading.
Listless means without energy or interest. Here, the actor seems tired and dull as Ram.
A portrayal is the way an actor or artist shows a character.
To dramatise a true or old story is to turn it into a play, show or film.
Taking creative liberties means changing parts of a story to make it work better, instead of copying it exactly.
To humanise someone is to make them feel more like a real person, with feelings and flaws.
Sacred means holy, or deserving great respect because of religion.
To glorify something is to make it seem wonderful or admirable. Here, critics say the film makes the villain look too cool.
John Milton was an English poet who wrote Paradise Lost, a long poem about Satan and the fall of humans.
Paradise Lost is a famous long poem from the 1600s. Many readers found its Satan more interesting than the heroes.
Sympathetic here means likeable enough that you feel for the person, even a bad one.
Adipurush is a 2023 Indian film of the same story. People were so angry about it that some wanted it banned.
To provoke a reaction is to cause it, often an angry one.
Fury is very strong anger.
Cartoonish means looking silly or unreal, like a cartoon.
A public-interest lawsuit is a court case brought, not for personal gain, but because someone thinks it protects the public.
Distribution is getting a film out to theaters and streaming services so people can see it.
Streaming platforms are services like Netflix that let you watch movies over the internet.
A faithful retelling sticks closely to the original story.
To conquer is to defeat or overcome. Here is the joke: Ram can beat a demon, but not a weak script.
A script is the written text of a movie, with its story and every line the actors say.
